NONE: › used for a person who supports particular beliefs, actions, or ideas, especially when added to the name of the person who is the origin of the ideas
（尤用於人名後，表示其思想或行動的）追隨者，支持者

example: a Thatcherite
柴契爾的追隨者
a Reaganite
雷根的支持者

NONE: B1 something that is part of a list or group of things
條，項目
› one of several subjects to be considered
項目
B2 a piece of news on television or radio, or in a newspaper
（電視、廣播或報紙上的一條）新聞
› one thing at a time
逐項，逐件

example: the last item on the list
名單上的最後一項
The restaurant has a long menu of about 50 items.
這家餐館的菜單很長，大約有50道菜。
Several items of clothing (= clothes) lay on the floor.
地板上有幾件衣服。
There are three items on the agenda.
議事日程上有三個項目。
There's an interesting item on the back page.
最後一版上有一條有趣的新聞。
Buyers from stores are given the opportunity to go through fashion collections item by item and place orders.
從商店來的買主有機會逐件細看時裝系列中的衣物並下訂單。

NONE: › to list things separately, often including details about each thing
逐個記載，詳細列出

example: We asked for an itemized bill, listing all our phone calls and how long they were.
我們要了一份明細帳單，上面列有我們打過的所有電話和通話時間。

NONE: › to repeat a process, especially as part of a computer program
反覆（尤指電腦程式裡重複某一過程）
› formal the process of doing something again and again, usually to improve it, or one of the times you do it
反覆（通常為了作出改善而重複做某事）
› specialized mathematics, computing an amount that you get when you use a mathematical rule several times
反覆運算，疊代，迭代（數學裡若干次使用一個數學法則得出的量）

example: the repetition and iteration that goes on in designing something
在設計某物時的重複與反覆修改
The software is on its fifth iteration.
這個軟體已經是第五版。

NONE: › doing something again and again, usually to improve it
（通常為了改進）重複的，反復的
